title.tagline: A coverage decision brief and quote-request package for a coastal Alabama buyer.

primer.title: Why Coastal Quotes Vary So Much
primer.subtitle: Same house, same coverage: premiums can differ by more than 100% across carriers (ALDOI).

cards.label: WIND VS NON-WIND
cards.body: Coastal policies split into wind/hurricane and all-other-perils. Wind is the majority of the premium here and carries its own percentage deductible.

cards.label: THREE MARKETS, ONE HOUSE
cards.body: Coastal risks get placed three ways: admitted carriers, surplus lines (e.g. Lloyd's), or the AIUA wind pool. Surplus lines adds 6% AL tax, 25% minimum earned premium, and no guaranty fund.

cards.label: MITIGATION IS THE LEVER
cards.body: FORTIFIED certification and roof age move coastal premiums more than any coverage choice. ALDOI data shows 50%+ wind-mitigation reductions in Baldwin County cities.

cards.label: DEFAULTS ARE EXPENSIVE
cards.body: Agents quote conservative defaults when you specify nothing. This brief exists so every quote comes back on YOUR spec.

primer.source_note: Sources: ALDOI premium comparison; Alabama Coastal Insurance Shopper's Guide (Smart Home America).

flood.body: Zone X means flood coverage is optional and cheap, which is exactly when it is worth quoting. Storm surge and rain-driven flooding do not respect zone lines, and preferred-risk pricing exists because the actuarial risk is low, not zero.
flood.recommendation: Request an NFIP quote alongside every homeowners quote. Compare one private flood quote if any carrier offers it.

agent_script.title: Work the Script
agent_script.subtitle: Questions that separate a good policy from a cheap-looking one.
questions: Is the wind deductible triggered by 'named storm,' 'hurricane,' or 'wind/hail'? Show me the definition page.
Is roof settlement replacement cost, ACV, or a payment schedule by age?
Does this policy carry a cosmetic damage exclusion for roofs or siding?
What FORTIFIED credit applies if I certify the roof, in dollars on THIS quote?
Is this admitted or surplus lines? If surplus: what is the minimum earned premium, are fees fully earned, and is there guaranty-fund backing?
What is the total walk-out cost: premium plus every fee plus surplus lines tax? Quotes compare on that number, not the property premium.
What does the same policy cost with 1% and 5% wind deductibles?
Which discounts are already in this number: bundle, paid-in-full, alarm, claims-free?
red_flags: Dwelling coverage well below the replacement-cost estimate. Underinsurance disguised as savings.
RCV roof on the summary page but an age-triggered ACV or cosmetic-exclusion roof form buried in the endorsements list. Read the forms schedule.
ACV roof settlement on a shingle roof. The discount comes out of your first claim.
No wind deductible dollar figure shown, only a percentage.
Flood 'included' claims. Homeowners policies exclude flood; something else is being sold.
A quote delivered without a single question asked about the property.
agent_script.footer_note: A quote you can't compare is a quote you can't trust.
